schemas.name: CaseRecord
schemas.immutability_rules: Case state transitions are append-only. Case locked during active research.

schemas.name: ContradictionRecord
schemas.immutability_rules: Contradiction record immutable. Resolution status updates preserve history.

schemas.name: EvidenceRecord
schemas.canonical_boundary: Canonical (Layer 2). NotebookLM/DR output is NONCANONICAL until validated.
schemas.immutability_rules: Evidence content immutable after admission. Status changes are append-only.

schemas.name: FinancialFact
schemas.immutability_rules: Fact immutable. Restatement creates new fact.

schemas.name: HypothesisSet
schemas.immutability_rules: Set immutable after Charter approval. Hypothesis shifts recorded in shift_history.

schemas.name: HypothesisRecord
schemas.immutability_rules: Hypothesis statement immutable. Plausibility updates preserve history.

schemas.name: InvestigationReport
schemas.canonical_boundary: Canonical. Proposed evidence noncanonical until admitted.

schemas.name: PublicationRecord
schemas.canonical_boundary: Publication is NONCANONICAL for investment truth. Canonical for record.

schemas.name: ResearchableUniverseRecord
schemas.immutability_rules: Inclusion state changes are append-only (new version per change).

schemas.name: SecurityMaster
schemas.canonical_boundary: Canonical. All other registries reference SM-01 entity_id.
schemas.immutability_rules: `entity_id` immutable. Ticker changes create ticker_history entries.

schemas.name: SourceRecord
schemas.immutability_rules: Content never edited in place. Removal requires tombstone (EVIDENCE-DOCTRINE).

schemas.name: UnderwritingVerdict
schemas.canonical_boundary: Canonical. Recommendation to Founder is advisory.
